claim_being_audited: Whether the current release can be certified now as policy-compliant based on aggregate readiness, clean rehearsal results, and the proposed narrow rationale that certification is defensible if current release documentation reflects the current evaluation batch and expressly discloses the energy outage response weakness as a material limitation.
decision_criteria: Certification is compliant only if the current release documentation reflects current evaluation results.
Certification is compliant only if material segment weaknesses for named launch use cases are disclosed before launch or covered by approved mitigation/risk acceptance.
Aggregate readiness above threshold and clean rehearsal results are supportive but not sufficient when a required policy predicate remains unresolved.
Prior approvals and informal monitoring notes may inform context but cannot substitute for current evidence or approved acceptance.
evidence_requests: Provide the current release documentation or model card showing the current evaluation results and explicit disclosure of the energy outage response weakness for the named launch use case.
Provide approved risk acceptance or reviewed mitigation documentation, if certification is being justified without disclosure resolution.
Provide evidence that the current retrieval configuration change was evaluated in the current batch referenced for this release.
specific_concerns: The policy threshold is conditional on current release documentation reflecting current evaluation results and disclosing material segment weaknesses or having approved mitigation before launch, but no admissible evidence shows that the current documentation already does so.
The energy outage response slice is below the warning threshold for a named launch use case, which the policy treats as a material limitation unless resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance.
The informal monitoring comment is not a reviewed mitigation, approved risk acceptance, or disclosure artifact under the policy.
The prior approval predates the current retrieval configuration change and current evaluation batch, so it cannot carry the current certification decision.
unsupported_claims: That certification may proceed now on the present record. The available evidence supports aggregate readiness, but not satisfaction of the documentation/disclosure predicate required by policy.
Any implication that current model-card materials already reflect the current evaluation batch and expressly disclose the outage-response weakness.
Any implication that post-launch manual monitoring is an approved mitigation or risk acceptance sufficient to substitute for pre-launch disclosure or approval.
